regime_context: The policy regime is a sequenced campaign for lower real yields plus strategic re-industrialization: Treasury suppresses front-end yields structurally while the Fed keeps its hawkish credibility and withholds easing as inflation-gated optionality. The consensus 'coordinated' narrative overstates the formal agreement — revealed preference points to aligned incentives rather than an explicit deal, with the live stagflationary split (hot PCE, cracked payrolls) making the front-end trade more two-sided than the yield-suppression story admits.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场分阶段推进的行动：财政部在结构上压低前端收益率，而美联储维持鹰派可信度，把宽松作为以通胀为门槛的期权。市场共识的“协同”叙事高估了正式协议的程度——显示性偏好指向的是激励相容而非明确交易，而当前滞胀分化（PCE偏热、就业走弱）使前端交易比收益率压制的故事所显示的更具双向性。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The collapsed Iran ceasefire and realized Brent spike re-prime the energy rotation that already made XLE the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026; the administration's conflict posture keeps the oil supply premium headline-fragile but upside-skewed vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂与已兑现的布伦特油价飙升重新激活了能源轮动——该轮动在2026年第一季度已使XLE成为ETF资金流入最多的板块；行政当局的冲突姿态使石油供给溢价对消息面敏感但相对SPY偏向上行。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: FACT ceasefire-collapse, Brent ~$80 intraday 7/8
Rotation map: Energy was TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026, capital rotation real
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation or Hormuz-safe transit data would squeeze the conflict premium sharply, and energy equities can lag crude on a risk-off equity tape.
theses.dissent_zh: 若局势快速降级或霍尔木兹海峡通航数据安全，冲突溢价会被迅速挤压，而且能源股在风险偏好收缩的股市环境中可能跑输原油本身。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more over any rolling 20-day window while Brent stays above $75
falsifier.text_zh: 在布伦特原油维持在75美元上方的同时，XLE在任意滚动20日窗口内跑输SPY达5%或以上

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: The NATO structural spending super-cycle is the highest-confidence fiscal channel and persists regardless of tariff or ceasefire headline noise; revealed budgetary commitments favor defense primes and missile-defense exposure over cyclical sectors vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约结构性军费超级周期是置信度最高的财政渠道，并且无论关税或停火消息如何波动都持续存在；显示性预算承诺使国防龙头与导弹防御敞口相对SPY优于周期性板块。
evidence: NATO/Defense theater: FACT budget commitments, INFERENCE structural super-cycle
Open prediction: defense bid persists regardless of headline regimes
theses.dissent: ITA has already missed twice in the recent track record with large realized drawdowns, suggesting either crowding or a sector-specific overhang that can swamp the macro tailwind.
theses.dissent_zh: ITA在近期记录中已两次失手且回撤较大，说明可能存在拥挤交易或板块特有的压制因素，足以抵消宏观顺风。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by 8% or more before the 63-day horizon while no NATO budget reversal occurs
falsifier.text_zh: 在北约预算没有逆转的情况下，ITA在63日窗口内跑输SPY达8%或以上

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: XOP
theses.thesis: Exploration-and-production names carry higher torque to the realized oil spike than diversified energy, but with the same geopolitical fragility; the admin's Iran posture keeps the supply shock live while Treasury's strong-dollar bridge does not yet choke oil demand.
theses.thesis_zh: 勘探与生产类股票对已兑现的油价飙升具有比综合能源更高的弹性，但同样具备地缘脆弱性；行政当局的伊朗姿态使供给冲击持续存在，而财政部的强美元桥接尚未抑制石油需求。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: FACT Brent spike and ceasefire collapse
Dollar/debt theater: Bessent strong-dollar-while-cutting frame as FX bridge
theses.dissent: Higher beta cuts both ways — XOP will fall harder than XLE on any de-escalation headline or if DXY strength turns into a demand-destroying tightening impulse.
theses.dissent_zh: 高贝塔是双刃剑——任何局势降级消息或美元走强演变为抑制需求的紧缩冲击时，XOP的跌幅会大于XLE。

falsifier.text: XOP underperforms XLE by 4% or more over the 42-day window while Brent remains above $70
falsifier.text_zh: 在布伦特原油维持70美元上方的同时，XOP在42日窗口内跑输XLE达4%或以上

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold sits at the intersection of two opposing forces: the real-hike credibility phase (DXY well off highs but CME now pricing >70% Sept hike) argues against adding here, while the Iran re-escalation haven bid argues for it — the Fed's inflation-mandate-first revealed preference tilts the balance against gold vs SPY near-term.
theses.thesis_zh: 黄金处于两股相反力量交汇处：实际加息的可信度阶段（美元指数脱离高位，但CME对9月加息的定价已超过70%）不支持在此加仓，而伊朗局势升级的避险买盘则支持黄金——美联储以通胀使命为优先的显示性偏好使短期天平相对SPY不利于黄金。
evidence: Market state: CME FedWatch >70% Sept hike probability, gold $4,044–4,200 range
Fed path gap: market more dovish than Fed, end-2026 gap -14bp
Warsh Sintra response: inflation-mandate first, held hawkish line
theses.dissent: A genuine Mar-a-Lago dollar turn or a labor-crack-driven September pivot would flip gold sharply bullish as real yields and the dollar fall together.
theses.dissent_zh: 若出现真正的海湖庄园式美元转向，或就业走弱驱动的9月政策转向，黄金将随实际收益率与美元同步下跌而急剧转为看涨。

falsifier.text: Gold rallies above $4,450 while the Fed's Sept hike probability stays above 50%
falsifier.text_zh: 在美联储9月加息概率维持在50%以上时，黄金涨破4,450美元

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: The DOE HALEU fuel-bank release and AI-reactor program are real policy levers, but the current regime of rising front-end rate expectations and a hawkish Fed is the worst funding environment for pre-revenue nuclear SMR names; the policy catalyst is not yet priced as equity outperformance vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 美国能源部HALEU燃料库释放与AI反应堆计划是真实政策手段，但当前前端利率预期上行叠加美联储偏鹰，是未盈利核能小型模块化反应堆公司最差的融资环境；该政策催化剂尚未在相对SPY的股票表现中体现为超额收益。
evidence: Rotation targeted: Nuclear/uranium/HALEU proxies OKLO, SMR
Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into fuel bank
Track record: SMR overweight missed with -16.6% realized
theses.dissent: A concrete DOE contracted/sited reactor award or a Fed pivot signal would re-rate OKLO violently on policy momentum regardless of macro rates.
theses.dissent_zh: 若出现美国能源部实际签约或选址的反应堆项目，或美联储释放转向信号，OKLO可能因政策动能被剧烈重估，而无论宏观利率环境如何。

falsifier.text: OKLO outperforms SPY by 15% or more while no new contracted reactor award is announced
falsifier.text_zh: 在没有新的签约反应堆项目公布的情况下，OKLO跑赢SPY达15%或以上
